newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai investment board approves new projects.
newsitem.headline: Thai investment board approves new projects.

text.p: Thailand's Board of Investment (BOI) on Thursday decided to grant investment incentives to several projects with a total combined investment of 58.18 billion baht ($2.24 billion).
The largest investment project being granted incentives is the 14-billion baht petrochemical complex of TPI Olefins Co Ltd, a unit of Thai Petrochemical Industry Plc, BOI said in a statement.

TPI Olefins' new petrochemcal facility will have annual production capacity of 700,000 tonnes of ethylene, 420,000 tonnes of propylene, 165,000 tonnes of Butadiene and 175,000 tonnes of benzene, the board said.
The board also approved incentives for the 11.1 billion baht petrochemical plant of Esso (Thailand), an affiliate of U.S. oil major Exxon Corp.
Esso's new plant will have annual capacity of 350,000 tonnes of para-xylene, it said.
BOI incentives include exemption from import duty on machinery and exemption from corporate income tax for eight years.
